posts.title: Why We Envy Friends More Than Billionaires
posts.description: Why moderate superiority stings and vast superiority delights. On the rank instrument, the comparison class, the deservingness valve — and what admiration actually is.

posts.title: Why Your Friend's Success Stings
posts.description: Support during catastrophe is easy. Success is the harder test. On the two logics inside every adult friendship, and the one structural variable that converts a friend's excellence from threat into asset.

posts.title: Presence Is a Perishable Resource
posts.description: Co-presence is perishable; the text can usually wait. On presence as an option, why interruption costs more than its duration, and the value of unallocated attention.
